makemeahanzi.definition: gate, door, entrance, opening

characterDeckComponents.note: 门 is a picture of a double-leafed door or gate, drawn symmetrically to show two swinging panels.

makemeahanzi.definition: to decide, to fix, to settle; to order; definite, fixed, sure

etymology.hint: A person 疋 settling under a roof 宀

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (roof) — represents a home or fixed dwelling.
疋 (a foot/person) — a person settling down under a roof gave 定 its meaning 'to decide, to fix, to settle.'

makemeahanzi.definition: at, in, on; to, from; alas!
tube, pipe, duct; to manage, to control

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺮ (bamboo) — 管 originally referred to a bamboo pipe or tube, later broadening to mean 'to manage' or 'to control.'
官 (guān) gives a hint of the sound — 管 is pronounced guǎn, a connection that has shifted only slightly in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: bold, brave; to dare, to venture

etymology.hint: A hand with a stick 攵 striking a beast 耳

characterDeckComponents.note: 耳 — a wild beast being confronted
攵 (a hand with a stick) — striking at the beast, showing boldness

makemeahanzi.definition: mouth, lips

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 嘴 refers directly to the mouth, or a beak-like spout.
觜 (zī) gives a sound distantly related to zuǐ, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to hop, to skip; to jump, to leap; to vault; to dance

characterDeckComponents.note: 足 (foot) — 跳 describes an action done with the feet, jumping.
兆 (zhào) gives a rhyme close to tiào, with the initial and tone shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: to clutch, to grab, to seize

etymology.hint: A hand 扌 with claws 爪; 爪 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 抓 describes an action done by hand, grabbing.
爪 depicts claws or fingers gripping something, reinforcing 抓's meaning 'to grab, to seize.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to move, to happen; movement, action

characterDeckComponents.note: 力 (strength/force) — 动 relates to movement produced by exertion or force.

makemeahanzi.definition: to win, to gain; surplus, profit

characterDeckComponents.note: Money/shell — winning is linked to gaining wealth or profit.

makemeahanzi.definition: woman, girl; female

etymology.hint: A woman turned to the side

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 depicts a kneeling figure with arms crossed, a traditional posture — a simple picture of a woman.

makemeahanzi.definition: busy, hurried, pressed for time

etymology.hint: A heart 忄 faced with death 亡; 亡 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 忄 (heart) — 忙 describes an inner state, here one of pressure or urgency.
亡 depicts loss or fleeing — paired with the heart, it suggests a mind under pressure, giving 忙 its meaning 'busy, rushed.'

makemeahanzi.definition: team, group, band, army unit; measure word for groups of people

etymology.hint: A group of people 人 gathered in one place 阝

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (a mound or place) — 队 pictures people gathering together.
人 (person) — people gathering in one place gave 队 its meaning 'a team' or 'a line/queue.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to pull, to drag; to seize, to hold; to lengthen; to play (a violin)

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — relates directly to 拉's meaning 'to pull, drag,' an action done by hand.
立 (lì) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted noticeably from lā.

makemeahanzi.definition: aid, help; to rescue, to save

characterDeckComponents.note: 攵 (a hand taking action) — 救 describes the act of rescuing someone.
求 (qiú) gives a sound close to jiù, sharing a similar rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: to sleep, to doze

characterDeckComponents.note: 目 (eye) — 睡 relates to closing the eyes to sleep.
垂 (chuí) gives a sound partly close to shuì, sharing part of the rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: night, evening; late

etymology.hint: Avoiding 免 the sun 日; 免 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 日 (sun) — the sun is what disappears as evening falls
免 (to escape, avoid) — pictured as the sun slipping away, giving 晚 its sense of 'late, evening'

makemeahanzi.definition: to shut, to close; to obstruct, to block

etymology.hint: A door 门 blocked by bars 才

characterDeckComponents.note: 门 (a door) — the frame of a doorway.
才 here representing a bar or beam laid across it, together giving 闭 its meaning 'to close, shut, block up.'

makemeahanzi.definition: bad, rotten, spoiled; to break down

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 坏 relates to something crumbling or deteriorating, like broken soil.
不 (bù) reflects an old phonetic link that has largely faded in the modern pronunciation huài.

makemeahanzi.definition: to receive, to get, to accept; to bear

etymology.hint: Something 冖 passed from one hand 爫 to another 又

characterDeckComponents.note: 爫 (a hand, from above) — 受 pictures something being passed.
又 (a hand, from below) — one hand giving and another receiving gave 受 its meaning 'to receive' or 'to endure.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to join, to connect; continuous; even

etymology.hint: A cart 车 moving 辶 goods between cities

characterDeckComponents.note: 车 (cart) — the vehicle moving goods.
辶 (walking/movement) — the cart traveling along a road, linking one place to another, giving 连 its meaning 'to connect, link.'

makemeahanzi.definition: whole, entire, complete; to preserve

etymology.hint: Jade 玉 put away 入 for safe-keeping

characterDeckComponents.note: 入 (enter, put away) — 全 pictures something being placed into safekeeping.
玉 (jade) — a valuable treasure kept whole and undamaged, giving 全 its meaning of 'complete' or 'entire.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to straighten, to stand upright; rigid, stiff

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 挺 describes straightening or holding something upright, often with the hand or body.
廷 (tíng) gives a sound very close to tǐng, sharing the initial and rhyme — only the tone differs.

makemeahanzi.definition: this, these; in this case, then

characterDeckComponents.note: 匕 here relates to a person crouching or sitting — 此 originally pictured 'this place' where someone is.
止 (zhǐ) gives a hint of the sound — 此 is pronounced cǐ, sharing a similar final though the initial has shifted over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: water, liquid, lotion, juice

etymology.hint: A river running between two banks; compare 川

characterDeckComponents.note: 水 depicts a flowing stream, with a central current and ripples or drops branching off to the sides.

meanings: classifier for certain containers of liquids: glass, cup

makemeahanzi.definition: cup, glass; measure word for liquids

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 杯 names a cup, originally carved from wood.
不 (bù) shares the initial b- with bēi, though the rhyme has drifted from ù to ēi over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to sell; to betray; to show off

characterDeckComponents.note: 买 (to buy) — 卖 (to sell) is the flip side of buying, the other half of a transaction.
买 (mǎi) gives a sound very close to mài, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to trust, to believe; letter, sign
to dance; to brandish

etymology.hint: A hand 舛 holding a fan

characterDeckComponents.note: 無-shaped top pictures a dancer holding decorated sleeves or fans.
舛 below pictures a pair of feet, together giving 舞 its meaning 'to dance.'

makemeahanzi.definition: tall, lofty; high, elevated

characterDeckComponents.note: 高 depicts a tall tower or palace, with a roof at the top and a base below — a simple picture of height.

makemeahanzi.definition: to try, to experiment; exam, test

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 试 relates to proposing or trying something out
式 (shì) gives the sound — an exact match with 试's pronunciation shì

makemeahanzi.definition: beautiful, pretty; pleasing

etymology.hint: A person 大 wearing an elegant crown 羊

characterDeckComponents.note: 羊 (sheep; here representing feathers or ornaments on a headdress) — an elaborate decoration worn on the head.
大 (a person, arms outstretched) — a person wearing a decorated headdress was seen as beautiful, giving 美 its meaning 'beautiful.'

makemeahanzi.definition: book, letter, document; writing

etymology.hint: A mark made by a pen ⺺

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺺ — an abstract mark meant to depict strokes made by a writing brush, the origin of 书's meaning 'book, document, letter.'

makemeahanzi.definition: ball, globe, sphere; round

characterDeckComponents.note: 王 (a variant of 玉, meaning jade) — 球 originally referred to a round piece of jade, extended to mean 'ball, sphere'
求 (qiú) gives the sound — 球 is also pronounced qiú, an exact match

makemeahanzi.definition: to investigate, to examine, to look into
to forget, to miss, to neglect, to overlook

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart/mind) — 忘 relates to something slipping from the mind.
亡 (wáng) gives a sound distantly related to wàng, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to clap, to tap; to hit, to beat, to slap; beat, rhythm

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 拍 describes striking something lightly with the hand.
白 (bái) gives a sound distantly related to pāi, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: road, path, street; journey

characterDeckComponents.note: 足 (foot) — relates to 路's meaning 'road, path,' something walked on with feet.
各 (gè) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from lù.

makemeahanzi.definition: dull, simple, stupid

etymology.hint: One with wooden 木 speech 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — someone's speech.
木 (wood) — stiff and unresponsive, together giving 呆 its meaning 'dull, blank, foolish.'

makemeahanzi.definition: four

etymology.hint: A child 儿 in a room with four walls 囗

characterDeckComponents.note: 囗 (an enclosure) — 四 pictures a bounded space.
儿 (a person) — a person enclosed within four walls gave 四 its meaning 'four,' though the exact link to the number is debated.

makemeahanzi.definition: long ago; a long time
or, either, else; maybe, perhaps, possibly

etymology.hint: To defend yourself 口 with a spear 戈; "or else"

characterDeckComponents.note: 戈 (a spear or weapon) — 或 pictures defending a territory.
口 (here representing a walled area or territory) — defending one's territory with a weapon gave 或 its early sense of 'a certain place,' which later shifted to mean 'or,' offering an alternative.

makemeahanzi.definition: to understand, to know

characterDeckComponents.note: 忄 (heart/mind) — 懂 describes understanding something in the mind.
董 (dǒng) is an exact match for the sound of 懂.

makemeahanzi.definition: sequence, number; grade, degree; particle prefacing an ordinal

etymology.hint: Bamboo strips ⺮ arrayed in sequence; 弟 provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺮ (bamboo) — ancient texts were written on bound bamboo strips, and 第 originally referred to the sequential order of such strips, giving rise to its meaning 'ordinal number' (as in 第一, first).

meanings: horse or cavalry piece in Chinese chess

makemeahanzi.definition: horse; surname

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 馬, a horse galloping to the left

characterDeckComponents.note: 马 (simplified from 馬) depicts a horse in profile, with its mane, legs, and tail visible — later simplified into just a few strokes.

meanings: as far as sth is concerned

makemeahanzi.definition: talk, speech, lecture; to speak, to explain

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 讲 relates to speaking, explaining, telling
井 (jǐng) gives a sound close to 讲's reading jiǎng

meanings: (bound form) person engaged in a certain field of activity

makemeahanzi.definition: employee; member; personnel, staff

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (shell/money — cowrie shells were historically used as currency) — 员 originally related to counting or officials responsible for accounts, later broadening to mean 'member' or 'personnel.'

meanings: I see (used to indicate realization, understanding)

makemeahanzi.definition: onomatopoetic, the sound of crowing or crying

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 喔 relates to a sound being made.
屋 (wū) gives a sound distantly related to 喔's reading ō, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: used in 南無|南无[na1 mo2]

makemeahanzi.definition: no, not; lacking, -less
already; finished; to stop; then, afterwards
